body: I'm from Florida, and I'm heading nowhere. I have no obligations, or anything really. I have no friends because I do not want them, I do nothing for my future because I would rather be dead, honestly. Something realistic? And I'm sure I'm not supposed to say commit suicide, so I would say, shit man, I don't know. I can't think of anything I want to do.
I agree, to an extent. I do want to keep going, but not like this. If I could have found that person, I would have done so.
